check_in_values_check.name: check_in_values_check
check_in_values_check.value: ("check_ins"."measurement_type"='metric' and "check_ins"."value" is not null and "check_ins"."confidence" is null) or ("check_ins"."measurement_type"='confidence' and "check_ins"."confidence" between 0 and 100 and "check_ins"."confidence" is not null and "check_ins"."value" is null)

objective_alignment_check.name: objective_alignment_check
objective_alignment_check.value: ("objectives"."level"='company' and "objectives"."parent_objective_id" is null) or ("objectives"."level"='individual' and "objectives"."parent_objective_id" is not null)

scorecard_metric_range_check.name: scorecard_metric_range_check
scorecard_metric_range_check.value: ("scorecard_metrics"."direction" = 'range' and "scorecard_metrics"."upper_target" is not null and "scorecard_metrics"."upper_target" >= "scorecard_metrics"."target") or ("scorecard_metrics"."direction" <> 'range' and "scorecard_metrics"."upper_target" is null)

calendar_dates_check.name: calendar_dates_check
calendar_dates_check.value: ("calendar_events"."start_date" is null and "calendar_events"."end_date" is null and "calendar_events"."starts_at" is null and "calendar_events"."ends_at" is null) or ("calendar_events"."start_date" is not null and "calendar_events"."end_date" >= "calendar_events"."start_date" and (("calendar_events"."all_day" and "calendar_events"."starts_at" is null and "calendar_events"."ends_at" is null) or (not "calendar_events"."all_day" and "calendar_events"."starts_at" is not null and "calendar_events"."ends_at" > "calendar_events"."starts_at")))
